reason: Last year we did the party at home and it was cramped, and a place in Banino with 4.9 from 173 reviews saves me driving the whole preschool group to Gdańsk. For 4-6 year olds I'd take FUN, because without an animator I'd end up running the games myself anyway.
objection: The base price grows fast: kids from preschool are more like 12-15 than 8, so with the per-child fee, cafe service for the adults and the ban on bringing our own cake, FUN ends up at 1,200-1,400 zł. And the big hall in Gdańsk has more attractions for the money.
would_change_my_mind: If the moms on 'Mamy z Banina' said the animator is weak or the room is small for 15 kids, I'd go to the bigger hall in Gdańsk.
